tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page canvas of the public site. Light is the primary theme; dark is a near-black canvas, not navy.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `background`, `card`, `popover` and `muted` (16.5:1 light, 17.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: forms, panels, the border-beam inner fill.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns and the nav panel.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Burgundy. Solid fills only: primary buttons, the reading-progress bar, the active nav item, the portal's right half. Same value in both themes. On the dark `background` the fill is 2.1:1, so a dark-theme primary button reads by its white label (9.4:1), not by its edge — kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Burgundy as TEXT (prices, links, emphasis) on `background`. In dark it turns to warm white instead of a pink tint, so burgundy never sits as small text on near-black.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on `primary` and `accent` fills (9.4:1).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet blue-grey fill: ghost-button hover, neutral badge ground, method atmosphere.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Muted bands and wells behind secondary content.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, eyebrows, hints on `background`, `card` and `muted` (≥5.7:1 light, ≥9.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Deeper burgundy (light) / brighter burgundy (dark) for hover and pressed states of `primary` fills, and the 3px marker on the admin sidebar active item (#70112A, fixed). White text on it. The brand uses no rose or pink tints.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: text, 40% borders, 10% tinted grounds. Always paired with a message, never colour alone.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers (the default border colour on every element). Decorative only — 1.3:1, not a control edge.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Public form-field borders. 1.7:1 / 1.6:1 — below the 3:1 control-border floor; kept as the source has it. The admin uses `admin-control-edge`, which passes.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: `outline: 2px solid` + 2px offset on every focusable element (9.4:1 light, 17.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: block
tokens.usage: Deep navy band (page curtain, dark sections). Each theme has its own deliberately separate tone.

tokens.name: block-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `block`.

tokens.name: block-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `block` (7.8:1).

tokens.name: block-accent
tokens.usage: Warm ivory chip on navy or photography: property-card badge ground, the brand-mark plate in dark mode. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand navy that never inverts: logo letters, the portal's left half, the hero cover.

tokens.name: logo-accent
tokens.usage: Burgundy half of the portal symbol, on light and dark grounds alike (the inverse logo keeps it too). Never retinted.

tokens.name: on-image
tokens.usage: Text over photography, always above `image-scrim`.

tokens.name: on-image-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text over photography.

tokens.name: image-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim colour laid over photos (gradients to ~72%) so `on-image` text holds contrast.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text (draft and demo notices, amber badge) on `warning-surface` (6.3:1 light, 10.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Border of warning notices and amber badges.

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: Ground of warning notices and amber badges.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Off-white editorial paper of the home hero cover (fixed, both themes). `brand-ink` and `cover-ink` on it.

tokens.name: cover-window
tokens.usage: Stone placeholder behind the hero photo window before the image loads.

tokens.name: cover-ink
tokens.usage: Hero cover description text on `paper` (7.4:1).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the footer CTA (white text 7.9:1).

tokens.name: footer
tokens.usage: Curtain footer ground (both themes), topped by a 4px `primary` rule.

tokens.name: footer-ink
tokens.usage: Text and focus outline on `footer` (17:1).

tokens.name: footer-muted
tokens.usage: Footer eyebrows, column heads and small print on `footer` (11.5:1).

tokens.name: footer-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between footer rows.

tokens.name: footer-control
tokens.usage: Ground of the round social buttons in the footer.

tokens.name: footer-control-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the round social buttons on `footer` (4.6:1).

tokens.name: admin-background
tokens.usage: Admin panel canvas (`.panel` scope). The panel is denser and higher-contrast than the public site.

tokens.name: admin-foreground
tokens.usage: Admin text on `admin-background` and `admin-card`.

tokens.name: admin-card
tokens.usage: Admin cards, sidebar and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: admin-secondary
tokens.usage: Admin hover and neutral fills.

tokens.name: admin-muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Admin hints, descriptions and placeholders on `admin-background`, `admin-card` and `admin-field-surface` (≥5.5:1 light, ≥7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: admin-border
tokens.usage: Admin hairlines and secondary-button edges.

tokens.name: admin-field-surface
tokens.usage: Ground of admin inputs, selects and textareas.

tokens.name: admin-control-edge
tokens.usage: Admin field border (4.4:1 light, 5.0:1 dark on `admin-field-surface`).

tokens.name: admin-focus
tokens.usage: Admin focus ring: `outline: 3px solid` + 3px offset. Blue on purpose so it never reads as burgundy selection (7.9:1 / 11.9:1).

tokens.name: admin-primary-text
tokens.usage: Burgundy as text inside the admin; dark uses a light rose.

tokens.name: admin-selected
tokens.usage: Selected rows and tabs in the admin.

tokens.name: admin-selected-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `admin-selected` (7.9:1 / 8.2:1).

tokens.name: admin-primary-edge
tokens.usage: Border of admin primary buttons; in dark it lifts to rose so the button separates from the canvas.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Home hero headline. Archivo at wdth 92; fluid clamp(2.9rem, 7.8vw, 7.6rem). Sentence case.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: Editorial hero cover title on `paper`. wdth 96; clamp(2.125rem, 7.4vw, 6.25rem). One word may take `primary-text`.

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: Condensed UPPERCASE headline — the brand voice. Archivo wdth 68 (`width-display`), weight `weight-display`; 48px on mobile, 72px from md. Headlines only.

styles.name: public-display
styles.usage: Section h2 on the public experience: wdth 96, sentence case; clamp(2.2rem, 4.2vw, 4.2rem).
styles.sample: Seis etapas para coordinar tu venta

styles.name: display-soft
styles.usage: Soft display for card and empty-state titles: wdth 88 (`width-editorial`), weight `weight-editorial`.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Editorial home section titles in the serif; clamp(35px, 5vw, 64px).

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Pull statements, max 24ch; clamp(32px, 4.1vw, 56px).
styles.sample: Un documento recibido no es una firma.

styles.name: editorial-h3
styles.usage: Serif card heads in the deliverables and document lists.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy in `foreground`; Archivo at wdth 100.
styles.sample: Revisamos la documentación disponible antes de ofrecer el inmueble.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs, max 62ch, in `muted-foreground` or `cover-ink`.
styles.sample: Desde la primera revisión hasta la entrega, te explicamos qué sigue.

styles.name: property-title
styles.usage: Property-card title, balanced wrap.
styles.sample: Casa frente al mar en Playas

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Property price in `primary-text`.

styles.name: button-label
styles.usage: Editorial button and footer CTA labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE eyebrow above sections, in `muted-foreground` (the hero cover eyebrow is 11px, 0.16em, `primary-text`).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Card facts, footer small print.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: UPPERCASE location and meta line on cards, in `muted-foreground`.

styles.name: card-badge
styles.usage: UPPERCASE property-card badge on `block-accent`.

styles.name: admin-h1
styles.usage: Admin page title; clamp(1.75rem, 2.3vw, 2rem). Sentence case, wdth 100, no trailing period.

styles.name: admin-h2
styles.usage: Admin section heading.

styles.name: admin-h3
styles.usage: Admin sub-heading.

styles.name: admin-body
styles.usage: Admin base text and field values (inputs stay 16px so iOS never zooms).
styles.sample: Los inmuebles en borrador solo son visibles para tu equipo.

styles.name: admin-label
styles.usage: Field labels.

styles.name: admin-hint
styles.usage: Field hints and page descriptions in `admin-muted-foreground`.
styles.sample: Usa el precio acordado con el propietario.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: UPPERCASE status badges (IBM Plex Mono).

styles.name: document-serif
styles.usage: Libre Caslon Text, embedded only in the editorial property PDF sheet. Not used on the web.

spacing.note: Tailwind v4 default scale (4px base). These are the fixed lengths the components repeat.

tokens.name: space-unit
tokens.usage: Tailwind spacing base (`--spacing: 0.25rem`); every utility step is a multiple.

tokens.name: space-chip-inset
tokens.usage: Property-card badge offset from the image corner; card-badge padding is 7px 10px.

tokens.name: space-card-copy
tokens.usage: Gap between a property photo and its copy; editorial button side padding.

tokens.name: space-cta-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between an editorial button label and its arrow.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Footer top padding and the gap between large editorial columns.

tokens.name: gutter-min
tokens.usage: Editorial container side padding on phones; clamp(20px, 4vw, 60px).

tokens.name: gutter-max
tokens.usage: Editorial container side padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Editorial container max width.

tokens.name: control-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every admin control (`min-h-11`) and the card detail hit area.

tokens.name: button-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the public editorial button (footer CTA: 52px).

radius.note: Near-square. The brand is architectural: corners stay at 2–8px; pills and circles are reserved.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, notices (Tailwind `rounded-md`).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Base `--radius`; admin fields and secondary buttons; empty states.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Interactive cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Hero CTA links only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Round social buttons and the cursor guide.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare and only on hover or floating elements; resting surfaces use `border` hairlines.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Interactive card on hover (fine pointer, motion allowed). Source: foreground at 24%.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating editorial panels.

tokens.name: shadow-cursor
tokens.usage: The cursor guide disc.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Lifted editorial tiles. Source: foreground at 35%.

variation.note: Archivo variable-font axes, set with font-variation-settings "wdth".

tokens.name: weight-display
tokens.usage: Weight of `display-title`.

tokens.name: width-display
tokens.usage: wdth of `display-title` (condensed).

tokens.name: weight-editorial
tokens.usage: Weight of `display-soft`.

tokens.name: width-editorial
tokens.usage: wdth of `display-soft`.

zIndex.note: Fixed layers of the public experience.

tokens.name: z-reading-progress
tokens.usage: The 2px reading-progress bar.

tokens.name: z-cursor
tokens.usage: The cursor guide.

tokens.name: z-curtain
tokens.usage: The page-transition curtain.
